scale.1: Material repair needed before the requested use
scale.2: Usable with a bounded limitation; sound main decision
scale.3: Strong task-specific decision, finished artifact and substantiated check; explain why 2 is insufficient

decision_rules: Score actual artifacts against each case, not prose volume, helper count or checklist recital.
A critical factual, identity, rights or scope error prevents ready status regardless of total.
Name material differences before preferring one output. A tie is acceptable.
At two pairs per case, report descriptive results only. No significance, general efficacy, speed, cost or cross-model claim.
Keep all outputs and unsuccessful attempts. Treat qualitative preferences separately from mechanical checks.

criteria.name: Units and arithmetic
criteria.anchor_3: Reconciles reported 2024/2025 and the stated 2025 former-method counterfactual with correct denominators and directions; separates entries from distinct annual people and the national series.
criteria.anchor_1: Gives only the headline drop, mixes national/year/method units, or leaves key supplied counterfactual unused.

criteria.name: Causal discrimination
criteria.anchor_3: Uses the counterfactual to distinguish changed measurement from the remaining former-method difference, treats it as the agency claim, and specifies what data could settle a remaining rival without asserting a cause.
criteria.anchor_1: Blames the entire drop on counting or the shutdown, or dismisses all learning despite the supplied counterfactual.

criteria.name: Source reasoning
criteria.anchor_3: Traceable ledger separates official figures, modeled counterfactual, source assertions and own interpretation; missing 2024 visitor-hours or same-person data stay missing.
criteria.anchor_1: Invents unavailable trends or upgrades institutional assertion to independent corroboration.

criteria.name: Finished account
criteria.anchor_3: Readable 550–800 word explanation carries the consequential turn and useful uncertainty without becoming a generic report; source trail and arithmetic are inspectable.
criteria.anchor_1: A plan, generic caveats or unsupported dramatic story replaces the requested explanation.

critical: Misstates the reported headline numbers or old-method 2025 number materially.
Claims a proven 21% decline in distinct people or a proven sole causal explanation.
Fabricates observations, sources or missing series.

criteria.name: Reference transformation
criteria.anchor_3: Visible original composition translates specific mechanisms of the actual images; deliberate hierarchy handles their competing density/shape cues; notes agree with the artwork.
criteria.anchor_1: A photograph, traced motif, agency logo or vague style adjectives substitute for original synthesis.

criteria.name: Functional print design
criteria.anchor_3: Both editions are coherent usable A5 worksheets; required words and useful writing spaces have hierarchy and at least10pt physical legibility; black edition solves contrast structurally.
criteria.anchor_1: An attractive poster has no useful writing space, important text is too small, or monochrome destroys hierarchy.

criteria.name: Commitments and origin
criteria.anchor_3: Preserves identity, approved copy, 148×210mm and genuine one-black-ink condition; credits sources and makes no false scientific color key or endorsement.
criteria.anchor_1: Changes fixed text/format, retains colors in the black edition or invents event/science claims.

criteria.name: Observed finish
criteria.anchor_3: Editable saved sources and honest full-size/small local previews support actual check notes; no clipped copy; real remaining font/physical-print gaps are named.
criteria.anchor_1: Only directions/sketches or unperformed render/print assurances are delivered.

critical: Copies source photographs, agency marks or distinctive source lettering into final SVGs.
Required edition missing, wrong physical orientation/size, or materially unreadable/missing approved copy.
Claims a scientific color interpretation or official affiliation without support.

criteria.name: Advances the actual outcome
criteria.anchor_3: Produces a complete local A5 landscape FN-01 proof using available approved material; avoids turning unavailable gallery dependencies into prerequisites for the physical proof.
criteria.anchor_1: Delivers a plan or a replacement website/runtime instead of a usable local proof.

criteria.name: Preserves commitments
criteria.anchor_3: Exact approved copy, Field Notes/FN-01 identity and offline/physical scope survive; no unresolved portrait or FN-02 work is used/changed.
criteria.anchor_1: Changes approved words/identity or takes unrelated work as permission.

criteria.name: Usability and evidence
criteria.anchor_3: Readable artifact has an actual usable writing area and inspected saved source/preview; low-resolution image is not oversold as a final print proof.
criteria.anchor_1: Only source code or unsupported readiness claims; clipping, unreadable text or absent writing area.

criteria.name: Consequential continuation
criteria.anchor_3: One compact entrypoint explains what the proof settles and the specific next decision, with font/login/rights/physical printing limitations attached to the correct claim.
criteria.anchor_1: Another backlog, a busywork artifact when an essential authorization is missing, or a false upload claim.

critical: Uses the uncleared portrait or changes input work/FN-02.
No actual local proof despite the available approved materials.

boundary_review: Use canonical expected assertions/forbidden fields only in judge context. Judge whether the response preserves the actual request, refuses unsupported claims/access, and avoids unrelated artifacts. Do not reward generic refusal when a bounded requested result is possible.
